items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, we used to work together, where was it, in Cabaret, I believe, we worked, Dominick and I worked.

ctx.x: Yes, he was on that date too, those early ones with Ori and all, but I wondered any later ones, like, seems like Nanny Dominick told me he played with you. Now, where did he play with you?
Well, we used to work together, where was it, in Cabaret, I believe, we worked, Dominick and I worked.
Was that Sunset or any place?
